description: After check_direct_price asked you to open the hotel's own website for a stay, report the prices that site showed for the same dates and guests, and get the honest comparison with Booking.com. Give the check_id from check_direct_price and one entry per room or rate you saw, each with its total for the whole stay in euros and, when shown, its meal plan and cancellation terms. Report only what the hotel's own site showed; leave a field out when the site did not say it. The report is kept anonymously so the next traveller asking about the same stay gets an answer at once.

booking_cancellation.description: The cancellation terms of the Booking.com offer, when Booking.com shows them: free cancellation, non-refundable, or partly refundable.

booking_meal_plan.description: The meal plan of the Booking.com offer, when Booking.com shows it.

booking_room.description: The room name of the Booking.com offer, when shown.

booking_taxes_extra.description: Taxes Booking.com lists on top of its total, in euros (e.g. a city tax), when shown.

booking_taxes_included.description: true when Booking.com says its total includes taxes and charges; false when it lists taxes on top.

booking_total.description: The total Booking.com shows for the whole stay, in euros, when known. Without it you get the hotel's own price and, when the evidence allows, an estimated saving.

booking_url.description: Optional: the Booking.com address of the hotel's page (https://www.booking.com/hotel/…). Only the address is read, to recognise the hotel and the dates; the page is never opened.

children_ages.description: Each child's age on the day of check-out, one number per child. Leave out when no children travel. Hotels price children by age, so ages are needed for families.

city.description: The town or city the hotel is in, e.g. "Sitges". Helps find hotels we have not checked before.

hotel.description: The hotel's name as the traveller sees it, e.g. "Hotel Calipolis".

offers.description: The rooms and rates the hotel's own site showed for the stay.

code.description: A promo code the hotel's site shows publicly and that this price uses, if any.

member_price.description: true when this is a price for members of the hotel's free club.

rate.description: Rate name, when shown (e.g. "Non refundable", "Web offer").

room.description: Room name as the hotel's site shows it.

total.description: Total for the whole stay, in euros.

tourist_tax.description: The tourist tax amount for the stay, when the site states it.

tourist_tax_included.description: true when the site says the total includes the local tourist tax; false when it says the tax comes on top or is paid at the hotel.

page_url.description: The address of the hotel's page where you saw the prices (only its host is kept).

name: report_hotel_price
title: Report the prices seen on the hotel's own site
